requirement.statement: DeepSeek adapter SHALL preserve each assistant tool-call message's `reasoning_content` as provider continuation state and SHALL pass it back with `content` and `tool_calls` in all subsequent tool and user interaction requests; field preservation MUST NOT depend on whether the reasoning text is empty, mirrors content, or is hidden by the TUI presentation policy.

case.given: DeepSeek thinking mode returns non-empty reasoning_content with an assistant tool call
case.when: the tool result is appended and the next provider request is built
case.then: the assistant content, reasoning_content, and tool_calls SHALL be passed back unchanged before the corresponding tool result

case.given: a DeepSeek-compatible stream returns an empty reasoning_content field or reasoning text that mirrors content
case.when: the stream is aggregated and the next tool continuation request is built
case.then: the reasoning_content field SHALL remain present in the provider message
TUI display deduplication MUST NOT delete the wire-level continuation value

case.given: a historical DeepSeek session contains an assistant tool-call message persisted before this fix without reasoning_content
case.when: the session is loaded and a subsequent DeepSeek request is prepared
case.then: the adapter SHALL provide a DeepSeek-only empty reasoning_content compatibility value without rewriting the session file

case.given: an ordinary OpenAI adapter processes an assistant tool-call message without reasoning_content
case.then: the system MUST NOT inject the DeepSeek compatibility field
